## 4.4.2.1 D Port Type D port output can support three types: NPN output, PNP output, and push-pull output. Default Ou_P&P (Push-Pull). | Parameter | Meaning | |---|---| | Ou_NPN | When the output signal of port D is valid, port D outputs a low-level signal (0V), and when it is invalid, it is high impedence | | Ou_PNP | When the output signal of port D is valid, port D outputs a high-level signal (24V), and when it is invalid, it is high impedence | | Ou_P&P
(Push Pull) | When the output signal of port D is valid, port D outputs a high-level signal (24V).
When the output signal of port D is invalid, port D outputs a low-level signal (0V) | The diagram is as follows: [[vcrop:39:0]]
